text:
lina (Docs): Hey team — opened a small docs PR to add a concrete quickstart for an airgapped Private install on Ubuntu 22.04 using netplan + dnsmasq (plus a short Windows Server 2022 note). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4032. Asking for review from eng + security because it touches KMS/HSM connectivity guidance.

raj (Eng-Platform): Thanks — skimming now. Couple asks: 1) can we show how to pin the offline bundle checksum with `sha256sum` example? 2) include a tiny troubleshooting section for MTLS handshakes failing when HSM is behind NAT.

lina (Docs): yea I'll add a checksum snippet and a one-paragraph MTLS checklist. Draft netplan + dnsmasq example is in the PR, posting the excerpt here to make review easy: 

```
# /etc/netplan/01-redwood.yaml
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: networkd
  ethernets:
    eth0:
      dhcp4: no
      addresses: ["10.0.5.10/24"]
      gateway4: 10.0.5.1
      nameservers:
        addresses: ["127.0.0.1", "8.8.8.8"]
```

And a minimal dnsmasq.conf for local resolution of internal-hosts: 
```
# /etc/dnsmasq.d/redwood.conf
no-resolv
server=8.8.8.8
listen-address=127.0.0.1
address=/redwood-internal/10.0.5.20
```

Note: we explain to run `systemctl restart dnsmasq` and `netplan apply` and verify with `dig @127.0.0.1 redwood-internal`.

sam (Eng-ML): Nice. For the HSM/KMS bit, can we include a tiny PKCS#11 probe command so ops can confirm the HSM is reachable pre-install? e.g. `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libykcs11.so -L`. If the agent requires an intermediate NAT mapping, document port-forwarding or a TLS tunnel (we use socat in the field).

raj (Eng-Platform): Also add a note about MTU: some customers hit fragmentation with 1500 vs jumbo frames when the HSM is on a different rack — recommend testing with `ping -s` to exercise large TLS records.

alicja (Security): Quick sec ask: for the sample dnsmasq config don't include real IPs for HSM/KMS credentials or any example RSA private key text. Include a short callout to rotate service account keys if bundle is moved between environments. I'll add a doc snippet for recommended KMS access roles.

marta (Support): One more real-world request: customers occasionally run the installer on an image with cloud-init that rewrites `/etc/hosts`. Could we add a short playbook step to re-apply hosts after cloud-init first-boot? Maybe an idempotent systemd unit or a one-liner `sed` command.

lina (Docs): Good call — adding a sample systemd unit. Draft: 
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-hosts-fix.service
[Unit]
Description=Fix /etc/hosts after cloud-init
After=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/fix-hosts.sh
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
and `/usr/local/bin/fix-hosts.sh` will be a safe `grep -q` guard before any writes.

raj (Eng-Platform): For the Windows note — please include the small registry key tweak customers hit for time sync for HSM cert verification (we saw drift issues). A single-line PowerShell sample is useful.

lina (Docs): Adding a Windows section with this sample PowerShell call for NTP + a note about disabling Hyper-V time sync if using nested VMs. Sample: `w32tm /config /syncfromflags:manual /manualpeerlist:\"time.windows.com\" /update` then `w32tm /resync`.

deploy-bot: CI for PR #4032 — docs build OK, linkcheck failed on one internal link: /private/install/old-legacy-example -> 404.

lina (Docs): thanks deploy-bot — will remove the stale link and replace with the new minimal-install anchor.

sam (Eng-ML): One more SDK snippet request: offline-node SDK sample for uploading the offline bundle to the private deploy's bundle endpoint via an HTTP proxy. Small node fetch sample helps: 
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
await fetch('http://10.0.5.20:8443/api/bundles', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>' },
  body: fs.createReadStream('bundle.tar.gz'),
  agent: new HttpsProxyAgent('http://127.0.0.1:3128')
});
```

raj (Eng-Platform): Perfect. If you can add a tiny troubleshooting table (symptom -> first-check) we'll be able to triage support tickets faster.

lina (Docs): Will do. Plan: I’ll push another commit today that: removes the stale link, adds the checksum + MTU/MTLS troubleshooting checks, includes the pkcs11 probe example and the Windows NTP note, and adds the node SDK snippet and systemd hosts-fix unit. Targeting to request final reviews by EOD so we can merge before next week's Private release.

marta (Support): Happy to sanity-check the troubleshooting table after you push.

alicja (Security): I can do a quick pass on the KMS roles blurb after your commit.

lina (Docs): Thanks all — updating now. Tagging @raj @sam @alicja @marta for final quick LGTM when the commit lands. :thumbsup:
